description: Compute the WCAG 2.1 contrast ratio between a text and background color with pass/fail against every accessibility threshold: AA and AAA for normal and large text, plus the 3:1 UI-component minimum. Exact luminance math — the check every design system needs. Use this when an agent needs to contrast ratio + AA/AAA pass/fail. x402 price $0.002/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
